import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- A row of the augmented system: coefficient list together with its right hand side. -/
abbrev GRow := List Nat × Nat

/-- Dot product of a coefficient vector with an assignment (missing entries count as 0). -/
def dotp : List Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _, [] => 0
  | a :: as, x :: xs => a * x + dotp as xs

/-- Componentwise addition of two coefficient vectors modulo 2. -/
def addV : List Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], bs => bs
  | as, [] => as
  | a :: as, b :: bs => (a + b) % 2 :: addV as bs

/-- The GF(2) row operation `r := r + p`. -/
def addRow (r p : GRow) : GRow := (addV r.1 p.1, (r.2 + p.2) % 2)

/-- `r` satisfies the equation of the row (modulo 2). -/
def satR (r : GRow) (x : List Nat) : Prop := dotp r.1 x % 2 = r.2 % 2

/-- Find the first row whose leading coefficient is 1 and split it off as pivot. -/
def pivotSplit : List GRow → Option (GRow × List GRow)
  | [] => none
  | r :: rs =>
      if r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 then some (r, rs)
      else
        match pivotSplit rs with
        | none => none
        | some (p, rest) => some (p, r :: rest)

/-- One elimination step: clear the leading column of every remaining row using the
    pivot row, then drop that (now zero) column. -/
def elimStep (p : GRow) (rest : List GRow) : List GRow :=
  rest.map (fun r =>
    if r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 then ((addRow r p).1.tail, (addRow r p).2)
    else (r.1.tail, r.2))

/-- Drop the leading (all zero) column of every row. -/
def dropCol (rows : List GRow) : List GRow := rows.map (fun r => (r.1.tail, r.2))

/-- Gaussian elimination over GF(2) on `n` unknowns with back substitution folded in. -/
def gaussSolve : Nat → List GRow → Option (List Nat)
  | 0, rows => if (∀ r ∈ rows, r.2 % 2 = 0) then some [] else none
  | n + 1, rows =>
      match pivotSplit rows with
      | some (p, rest) =>
          match gaussSolve n (elimStep p rest) with
          | none => none
          | some xs => some ((p.2 + dotp p.1.tail xs) % 2 :: xs)
      | none =>
          match gaussSolve n (dropCol rows) with
          | none => none
          | some xs => some (0 :: xs)

/-- The augmented system built from the input matrix and right hand side. -/
def buildRows (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : List GRow :=
  (List.range matrix.length).map (fun i => (matrix.getD i [], b.getD i 0))

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  gaussSolve (matrix.getD 0 []).length (buildRows matrix b)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma dotp_nil_right : ∀ (as : List Nat), dotp as [] = 0
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: _ => rfl

lemma dotp_cons (r : List Nat) (x0 : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    dotp r (x0 :: xs) = r.headD 0 * x0 + dotp r.tail xs := by
  cases r with
  | nil => simp [dotp]
  | cons a as => simp [dotp]

lemma addV_nil_right : ∀ (as : List Nat), addV as [] = as
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: _ => rfl

lemma addV_tail (as bs : List Nat) : (addV as bs).tail = addV as.tail bs.tail := by
  cases as with
  | nil => simp [addV]
  | cons a as =>
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [addV, addV_nil_right]
    | cons b bs => simp [addV]

lemma addV_dot (as : List Nat) : ∀ (bs xs : List Nat),
    dotp (addV as bs) xs % 2 = (dotp as xs + dotp bs xs) % 2 := by
  induction as with
  | nil => intro bs xs; simp [addV, dotp]
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro bs xs
    cases bs with
    | nil => simp [addV, dotp]
    | cons b bs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp [dotp_nil_right]
      | cons x xs =>
        have ih' : dotp (addV as bs) xs ≡ dotp as xs + dotp bs xs [MOD 2] := ih bs xs
        have h1 : (a + b) % 2 * x ≡ (a + b) * x [MOD 2] :=
          Nat.ModEq.mul_right x (Nat.mod_modEq (a + b) 2)
        have h3 := Nat.ModEq.add h1 ih'
        have e : (a + b) * x + (dotp as xs + dotp bs xs)
            = a * x + dotp as xs + (b * x + dotp bs xs) := by ring
        rw [e] at h3
        show ((a + b) % 2 * x + dotp (addV as bs) xs) % 2
            = (a * x + dotp as xs + (b * x + dotp bs xs)) % 2
        exact h3

lemma mul_mod_two_of_odd (h x : Nat) (hh : h % 2 = 1) : h * x % 2 = x % 2 := by
  have h1 : h * x ≡ 1 * x [MOD 2] := Nat.ModEq.mul_right x hh
  simpa using h1

lemma mul_mod_two_of_even (h x : Nat) (hh : h % 2 = 0) : h * x % 2 = 0 := by
  have h1 : h * x ≡ 0 * x [MOD 2] := Nat.ModEq.mul_right x hh
  simpa using h1

lemma pivotSplit_spec : ∀ (rows : List GRow) (p : GRow) (rest : List GRow),
    pivotSplit rows = some (p, rest) →
      p.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 ∧ p ∈ rows ∧ (∀ r ∈ rest, r ∈ rows) ∧
        (∀ r ∈ rows, r = p ∨ r ∈ rest) := by
  intro rows
  induction rows with
  | nil => intro p rest h; simp [pivotSplit] at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro p rest h
    rw [pivotSplit] at h
    by_cases hc : a.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
    · rw [if_pos hc] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
      subst h1; subst h2
      refine ⟨hc, List.mem_cons_self .., ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro q hq; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq
      · intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with h5 | h5
        · exact Or.inl h5
        · exact Or.inr h5
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h
      cases hps : pivotSplit as with
      | none => rw [hps] at h; simp at h
      | some pr =>
        obtain ⟨p', rest'⟩ := pr
        rw [hps] at h
        simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
        subst h1; subst h2
        obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4⟩ := ih p' rest' hps
        refine ⟨g1, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ g2, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro q hq
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with h5 | h5
          · exact h5 ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..
          · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (g3 q h5)
        · intro q hq
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with h5 | h5
          · exact Or.inr (h5 ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
          · rcases g4 q h5 with h6 | h6
            · exact Or.inl h6
            · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h6)

lemma pivotSplit_none_spec : ∀ (rows : List GRow),
    pivotSplit rows = none → ∀ r ∈ rows, r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 0 := by
  intro rows
  induction rows with
  | nil => intro _ r hr; simp at hr
  | cons a as ih =>
    intro h r hr
    rw [pivotSplit] at h
    by_cases hc : a.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
    · rw [if_pos hc] at h; simp at h
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h
      cases hps : pivotSplit as with
      | none =>
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with h1 | h1
        · subst h1; omega
        · exact ih hps r h1
      | some pr => rw [hps] at h; simp at h

theorem gauss_sound : ∀ (n : Nat) (rows : List GRow) (xs : List Nat),
    gaussSolve n rows = some xs → xs.length = n ∧ ∀ r ∈ rows, satR r xs := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro rows xs h
    rw [gaussSolve] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hall
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      intro r hr
      have hz := hall r hr
      show dotp r.1 [] % 2 = r.2 % 2
      rw [dotp_nil_right]
      omega
    · simp at h
  | succ n ih =>
    intro rows xs h
    rw [gaussSolve] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i p rest hps
      obtain ⟨hp1, hpmem, hrestmem, hcover⟩ := pivotSplit_spec rows p rest hps
      split at h
      · simp at h
      · rename_i ys hys
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst h
        obtain ⟨hlen, hsub⟩ := ih _ _ hys
        refine ⟨by simp [hlen], ?_⟩
        intro r hr
        rcases hcover r hr with rfl | hrr
        · show dotp r.1 _ % 2 = r.2 % 2
          rw [dotp_cons]
          have A : r.1.headD 0 * ((r.2 + dotp r.1.tail ys) % 2) % 2
              = ((r.2 + dotp r.1.tail ys) % 2) % 2 := mul_mod_two_of_odd _ _ hp1
          generalize r.1.headD 0 * ((r.2 + dotp r.1.tail ys) % 2) = t at A ⊢
          omega
        · by_cases hc : r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
          · have hmem : ((addRow r p).1.tail, (addRow r p).2) ∈ elimStep p rest := by
              have hm : (if r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 then ((addRow r p).1.tail, (addRow r p).2)
                  else (r.1.tail, r.2)) ∈ elimStep p rest :=
                List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r, hrr, rfl⟩
              rwa [if_pos hc] at hm
            have hs := hsub _ hmem
            simp only [satR, addRow, addV_tail] at hs
            rw [addV_dot] at hs
            show dotp r.1 _ % 2 = r.2 % 2
            rw [dotp_cons]
            have A : r.1.headD 0 * ((p.2 + dotp p.1.tail ys) % 2) % 2
                = ((p.2 + dotp p.1.tail ys) % 2) % 2 := mul_mod_two_of_odd _ _ hc
            generalize r.1.headD 0 * ((p.2 + dotp p.1.tail ys) % 2) = t at A ⊢
            omega
          · have hmem : (r.1.tail, r.2) ∈ elimStep p rest := by
              have hm : (if r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1 then ((addRow r p).1.tail, (addRow r p).2)
                  else (r.1.tail, r.2)) ∈ elimStep p rest :=
                List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r, hrr, rfl⟩
              rwa [if_neg hc] at hm
            have hs := hsub _ hmem
            simp only [satR] at hs
            show dotp r.1 _ % 2 = r.2 % 2
            rw [dotp_cons]
            have A : r.1.headD 0 * ((p.2 + dotp p.1.tail ys) % 2) % 2 = 0 :=
              mul_mod_two_of_even _ _ (by omega)
            generalize r.1.headD 0 * ((p.2 + dotp p.1.tail ys) % 2) = t at A ⊢
            omega
    · rename_i hps
      split at h
      · simp at h
      · rename_i ys hys
        simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst h
        obtain ⟨hlen, hsub⟩ := ih _ _ hys
        refine ⟨by simp [hlen], ?_⟩
        intro r hr
        have hc := pivotSplit_none_spec rows hps r hr
        have hs := hsub (r.1.tail, r.2)
          (by simp only [dropCol]; exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩)
        simp only [satR] at hs
        show dotp r.1 _ % 2 = r.2 % 2
        rw [dotp_cons]
        have A : r.1.headD 0 * 0 % 2 = 0 := mul_mod_two_of_even _ _ hc
        generalize r.1.headD 0 * 0 = t at A ⊢
        omega

theorem gauss_complete : ∀ (n : Nat) (rows : List GRow),
    gaussSolve n rows = none → ∀ x : List Nat, x.length = n → ¬ (∀ r ∈ rows, satR r x) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro rows h x hx hsat
    rw [gaussSolve] at h
    split at h
    · simp at h
    · rename_i hall
      push_neg at hall
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hne⟩ := hall
      have hs := hsat r hr
      simp only [satR] at hs
      rcases x with _ | ⟨x0, xs⟩
      · rw [dotp_nil_right] at hs; omega
      · simp at hx
  | succ n ih =>
    intro rows h x hx hsat
    rw [gaussSolve] at h
    rcases x with _ | ⟨x0, xs⟩
    · simp at hx
    · have hxs : xs.length = n := by simpa using hx
      split at h
      · rename_i p rest hps
        obtain ⟨hp1, hpmem, hrestmem, hcover⟩ := pivotSplit_spec rows p rest hps
        split at h
        · rename_i hnone
          refine ih (elimStep p rest) hnone xs hxs ?_
          intro rr hrr
          obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hrr
          have hsr := hsat r (hrestmem r hr)
          have hsp := hsat p hpmem
          simp only [satR] at hsr hsp
          rw [dotp_cons] at hsr hsp
          by_cases hc : r.1.headD 0 % 2 = 1
          · rw [if_pos hc]
            show dotp (addRow r p).1.tail xs % 2 = (addRow r p).2 % 2
            simp only [addRow, addV_tail]
            rw [addV_dot]
            have A : r.1.headD 0 * x0 % 2 = x0 % 2 := mul_mod_two_of_odd _ _ hc
            have B : p.1.headD 0 * x0 % 2 = x0 % 2 := mul_mod_two_of_odd _ _ hp1
            generalize r.1.headD 0 * x0 = t at A hsr
            generalize p.1.headD 0 * x0 = u at B hsp
            omega
          · rw [if_neg hc]
            show dotp r.1.tail xs % 2 = r.2 % 2
            have A : r.1.headD 0 * x0 % 2 = 0 := mul_mod_two_of_even _ _ (by omega)
            generalize r.1.headD 0 * x0 = t at A hsr
            omega
        · simp at h
      · rename_i hps
        split at h
        · rename_i hnone
          refine ih _ hnone xs hxs ?_
          intro rr hrr
          simp only [dropCol] at hrr
          obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hrr
          have hsr := hsat r hr
          have hc := pivotSplit_none_spec rows hps r hr
          simp only [satR] at hsr
          rw [dotp_cons] at hsr
          show dotp r.1.tail xs % 2 = r.2 % 2
          have A : r.1.headD 0 * x0 % 2 = 0 := mul_mod_two_of_even _ _ hc
          generalize r.1.headD 0 * x0 = t at A hsr
          omega
        · simp at h

lemma foldl_add_sum {α : Type} (g : α → Nat) : ∀ (l : List α) (a : Nat),
    l.foldl (fun acc j => acc + g j) a = a + (l.map g).sum := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons y ys ihl =>
    intro a
    rw [List.foldl_cons, ihl, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.add_assoc]

lemma getD_zero_head (c : List Nat) : c.getD 0 0 = c.headD 0 := by cases c <;> rfl

lemma getD_succ_tail (c : List Nat) (j : Nat) : c.getD (j + 1) 0 = c.tail.getD j 0 := by
  cases c <;> simp

lemma dotp_eq_sum : ∀ (x c : List Nat),
    dotp c x = ((List.range x.length).map (fun j => c.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0)).sum := by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | nil => intro c; simp [dotp_nil_right]
  | cons x0 xs ihx =>
    intro c
    rw [dotp_cons]
    have hfun : ((fun j => c.getD j 0 * (x0 :: xs).getD j 0) ∘ Nat.succ)
        = (fun j => c.tail.getD j 0 * xs.getD j 0) := by
      funext j
      simp [getD_succ_tail]
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
      List.map_map, hfun, getD_zero_head, List.getD_cons_zero]
    rw [ihx c.tail]

lemma spec_eq_dotp (c x : List Nat) :
    (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + c.getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 = dotp c x := by
  rw [foldl_add_sum, dotp_eq_sum x c, Nat.zero_add]

lemma getD_mem_of_lt (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) : l.getD i 0 ∈ l := by
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem l 0 h]
  exact List.getElem_mem h

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hm0, hn0, hlen, -, -, hmat, hb⟩ := h_precond
  have hbmod : ∀ i, i < matrix.length → (b.getD i 0) % 2 = b.getD i 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hmem : b.getD i 0 ∈ b := getD_mem_of_lt b i (by omega)
    rcases hb _ hmem with h | h <;> omega
  simp only [solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond, solve_linear_system_gf2]
  cases hres : gaussSolve (matrix.getD 0 []).length (buildRows matrix b) with
  | none =>
    intro x hxlen _ hsol
    obtain ⟨-, hsol2⟩ := hsol
    refine gauss_complete _ _ hres x hxlen ?_
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi
    have hthis := hsol2 i hi
    rw [spec_eq_dotp] at hthis
    show dotp (matrix.getD i []) x % 2 = (b.getD i 0) % 2
    rw [hthis]
    exact (hbmod i hi).symm
  | some xs =>
    obtain ⟨hlxs, hsat⟩ := gauss_sound _ _ _ hres
    refine ⟨hlxs, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    have hmem : (matrix.getD i [], b.getD i 0) ∈ buildRows matrix b :=
      List.mem_map.mpr ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩
    have hs := hsat _ hmem
    simp only [satR] at hs
    rw [spec_eq_dotp, hs, hbmod i hi]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
